description_en: Queries domain name configurations. You can query multiple feature configurations in a single request
description_zh: 调用本接口查询域名配置，一次可查询多个功能配置
name: DescribeVodDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. Only a single domain name can be queried at a time
parameters.help_zh: 点播加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The feature names. You can query multiple feature configurations in a single request. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For the features supported by accelerated domain names for ApsaraVideo VOD and their names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411639.html
parameters.help_zh: 功能名称。一次可查询多个功能配置信息，多个功能名称之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。点播加速域名支持配置的功能及各功能名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411639.html
parameters.name: function_names
